name: Elden Ring
notes: Explored every nook of the Lands Between. Shadow of the Erdtree expansion ready.
review: An unprecedented milestone in open-world game design. The world design, lore depth, and boss encounters are masterclasses in atmosphere.

name: Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty
notes: Dogtown atmosphere is peerless. Idris Elba's performance as Solomon Reed was phenomenal.
review: One of the greatest redemption arcs in modern gaming. Night City feels alive, dense, and deeply tragic.

name: The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom
notes: Building crazy flying contraptions with Ultrahand. Still uncovering the Depths.
review: Takes the sandbox freedom of Breath of the Wild and injects boundless physics-based engineering.

name: God of War Ragnarök
notes: Emotional conclusion to the Norse saga. The combat feel with the Draupnir spear is perfection.
review: A cinematic tour de force that seamlessly balances character drama with visceral action.

name: Hollow Knight
notes: Pantheon of Hallownest beaten. Still hyped for Silksong.
review: The pinnacle of the Metroidvania genre. Atmospheric melancholia combined with tight combat.

name: Red Dead Redemption 2
notes: Arthur Morgan's journey still brings a tear to my eye. Unrivaled attention to detail.
review: Not just a game, but a living, breathing historical simulation and dramatic masterpiece.

name: Resident Evil 4 Remake
notes: Knife parry mechanic makes close-quarters combat so exhilarating.
review: Shows how classic games should be remade. Preserves the spirit while modernizing every system.

name: Baldur's Gate 3
notes: Act 3 in the Lower City. Playing as a College of Lore Bard with chaotic choices.
review: Infinite roleplaying depth with world-class writing and voice acting.

name: Silent Hill 2 Remake
notes: On my to-play list for spooky season.

name: Ghost of Tsushima
notes: Replaying in Kurosawa black & white mode with Japanese audio.
review: Visually arresting landscapes and the most satisfying katana deflection combat ever built.
